blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We present CART, a computational pipeline for extracting political narratives from parliamentary discourse and organizing them into a data-driven taxonomy without relying on predefined narrative categories. It encodes parliamentary discourse using semantic representations, filters relevant and reliable content through unsupervised confidence estimation, extracts narrative statements using LLMs, and uses narrative clustering and cluster analysis to construct a narrative taxonomy. Applied to Greek Parliament proceedings surrounding the 2023 Tempi train crash, it identifies ten recurring narrative families concerning responsibility attribution, institutional failure, railway safety, accountability, privatization, and the political interpretation of the tragedy. Our results demonstrate how combining unsupervised learning with LLM narrative extraction enables large parliamentary corpora to be transformed into interpretable, data-driven taxonomies of political narratives.
blocks.zh: 我们提出CART,这是从议会讨论中提取政治叙事的计算管道,将其组织成一个数据驱动的分类学,而不依赖预先界定的叙事类别。 它使用语义表述编码议会话语,通过不受监督的信心估计过滤相关和可靠的内容,使用LLMs提取叙事声明,使用叙事分组和分组分析来构建叙事分类学. 它适用于希腊议会关于2023年Tempi火车坠毁的诉讼程序,它确定了十个反复出现的叙述家庭,涉及责任归属、体制失败、铁路安全、问责制、私有化以及对悲剧的政治解释。 我们的结果显示,将不受监督的学习与LLM叙事提炼相结合,能够把大型议会公司转变为可解释、数据驱动的政治叙事分类。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: On February 28, 2023, a passenger train collided head-on with a freight train near Tempi, Greece, causing 57 deaths. The disaster prompted sustained public and parliamentary debate over its causes, institutional responsibility, and the subsequent investigation. 1 1 1 Preliminary Committees , Inquiry Committees . These developments generated a large body of parliamentary discourse in which political actors framed the causes of the crash, assigned responsibility, and interpreted the investigation.
blocks.zh: 2023年2月28日,一列旅客列车与希腊滕皮附近的一列货运列车相撞,造成57人死亡. 这场灾难引发了公众和议会对其原因、机构责任以及随后的调查的持续辩论。 1 1 初步委员会、调查委员会。 这些事态发展引起了一大批议会讨论,政治行为者在讨论中确定了坠机原因,指定了责任,并对调查作了解释。

blocks.en: From a computational perspective, this setting poses a challenging narrative analysis problem. Parliamentary discourse is large, heterogeneous, and only partly relevant to the event, while no annotated relevance labels or predefined narrative categories are available. Political narratives must therefore be inferred from recurring interpretive claims. Manual coding is difficult at scale, making it necessary to identify relevant discourse, extract narratives, and organize them into interpretable families.
blocks.zh: 从计算的角度来说,这种设置造成了一个具有挑战性的叙事分析问题. 议会的议论内容广泛而多样,仅与事件部分相关,而无附加说明的相关标签或预先界定的叙事类别. 因此,必须从反复提出的解释性主张中推断出政治叙述。 手动编码在规模上是困难的,因此有必要识别相关的论述,取出叙述,并将其组织成可解释的家庭.

blocks.en: Political narratives shape policy Hajer (1997) , provide causal interpretations and attribute responsibility Stone (1989) , function as persuasive mechanisms Jones et al. (2014) , and enable emotional engagement McLaughlin et al. (2019) . Drawing on Nikolaidis et al. (2025) and Patterson and Monroe (1998) , we define political narratives as recurring, overt or implicit claims that promote a particular interpretation of an ongoing political issue. In this study, a narrative statement is a concise claim about the Tempi crash, its causes, responsibility, the investigation, or its broader political interpretation, while a narrative family is a group of semantically related statements expressing a recurring interpretation.
blocks.zh: 政治叙事塑造了政策"Hajer"(1997),提供因果解释和属性责任"斯通"(1989),发挥"琼斯等"(2014)的说服机制的作用,并促成"麦克劳克林等"(2019)的情感接触. 根据Nikolaidis等人(2025年)和Patterson和Monroe(1998年),我们把政治叙事定义为反复出现、公开或隐含的主张,以促进对一个正在发生的政治问题的特定解释。 在本研究中,叙述性陈述是对"通平"坠机事件,其原因,责任,调查,或其更广泛的政治解释的简明说法,而叙述性家庭则是一组表达反复解释的有血缘关系的声明.

blocks.en: Advances in Natural Language Processing (NLP), Machine Learning (ML), and Large Language Models (LLMs) have supported growing interest in the analysis of narratives and political discourse Anning (2023) ; Berta et al. (2024) ; Kotseva et al. (2023) . However, existing approaches typically address thematic analysis, narrative extraction, or taxonomy construction separately, providing limited support for settings in which relevant discourse must first be isolated from a much larger corpus and narrative categories are not known in advance. This motivates the need for a workflow that combines thematic filtering, narrative extraction, and taxonomy construction.
blocks.zh: 自然语言处理(NLP),机器学习(ML),和大语言模型(LLMS)的进步,都支持了对叙事分析和政治言论Anning(2023),Berta等(2024),Kotseva等(2023)的日益浓厚的兴趣. 然而,现行办法通常分别处理专题分析、叙述取出或分类结构,对必须首先将相关论述从一个大得多的主体中分离出来,而且叙述类别事先不为人知的环境提供有限的支持。 这就促使需要建立一个工作流程,将专题过滤、叙述取出和分类构造结合起来。

blocks.en: To address this challenge, we propose CART ( C lustering-based A nalysis of R ecurring narratives for T axonomy construction), a computational pipeline that combines semantic text representations for paragraph encoding, unsupervised confidence-guided filtering to retain relevant and reliable content, LLM-assisted narrative extraction validated through manual annotation, and narrative clustering followed by cluster analysis to construct a data-driven taxonomy (illustrated in Fig. 1 ). Our study investigates political narratives surrounding the Tempi train crash through a computational analysis of Greek parliamentary discourse. Specifically, we address two research questions: (i) how political narratives can be systematically extracted and organized from large-scale discourse using computational methods, and (ii) which narrative families characterize parliamentary debate surrounding the Tempi train crash.
blocks.zh: 为了应对这一挑战,我们提议采用CART(以C取精为主的对R evening discriptions for T axonomy building),即将语义文字表述与段落编码相结合的计算管道,不加监督地进行信任指导的过滤以保留相关和可靠的内容,LLM辅助的叙述取出通过人工注释验证,然后进行叙事分组分析以构建由数据驱动的分类学(在图一中被忽略)。 通过对希腊议会言论的计算分析, 具体来说,我们处理两个研究问题:(一) 如何通过计算方法从大规模言论中系统地取出并组织政治叙事;(二) 议会围绕Tempi列车相撞的辩论中,哪些叙事家庭是其特点。

blocks.en: The study makes two contributions. Empirically, it identifies and organizes recurring political narratives surrounding the Tempi train crash into a data-driven taxonomy, providing a structured account of responsibility attribution, institutional failure, railway safety, accountability, privatization, and the political interpretation of the tragedy. Methodologically, it introduces CART , a computational workflow for extracting narrative statements and deriving interpretable narrative families without relying on predefined narrative categories. To facilitate reproducibility, both the implementation and the processed dataset are publicly available at https://github.com/semoglou/cart .
blocks.zh: 这项研究作出了两项贡献。 从经验上讲,它确定并组织关于Tempi列车坠入数据驱动分类系统的反复出现的政治叙事,提供了责任归属、体制失败、铁路安全、问责制、私有化以及对悲剧的政治解释的有条理的叙述。 从方法上来说,它引入了CART(CART),这是一个计算工作流程,用于提取叙述性陈述并生成可解释的叙述性家族而无需依赖预先定义的叙述性分类. 为了便于复制,可在https://github.com/semoglou/cart上公开查阅执行情况和处理过的数据集。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Most approaches to narrative extraction focus on identifying structural elements such as actors, actions, and events. Traditional NLP methods use tools such as Semantic Role Labeling, Abstract Meaning Representation, and Named Entity Recognition to extract core narrative elements, entity–verb–entity triples, semantic graphs, or specific actors from text Anantharama et al. (2022) ; Jing and Ahn (2021) ; Pournaki and Willaert (2025) ; Amorim et al. (2024) .
blocks.zh: 大多数叙事提取方法都注重确定诸如行为者、行动和事件等结构性要素。 传统的NLP方法使用诸如语义角色标签,抽象意义代表,和取名实体识别等工具,从文本Anantharama等(2022)中取出核心叙事要素,实体-动词-实体三重体,语义图,或特定角色;Jing和Ahn (2021);Pournaki和Willaert (2025);Amorim等(2024).

blocks.en: More recently, LLM-based approaches have enabled the extraction of character roles, interpretive frames, and broader narrative structures with less domain-specific training data Otmakhova and Frermann (2025) ; Stammbach et al. (2022) . However, they may still rely on predefined categories, carefully designed prompts, or exhaustive processing of large corpora, particularly when only part of the corpus is relevant.
blocks.zh: 最近,基于LLM的方法使得角色角色的提取,解释框架,以及较宽的叙事结构,其域特有培训数据较少的Otmakhova和Frermann (2025). Stammbach等 (2022). 然而,它们仍然可能依赖于预先界定的类别、精心设计的提示,或对大公司进行彻底的处理,特别是当只有部分程序是相关的。

blocks.en: For taxonomy construction, traditional approaches often rely on expert-driven manual coding to identify domain-specific narratives and construct narrative codebooks Hughes et al. (2021) ; Kotseva et al. (2023) . Recent work has also developed hierarchical taxonomies that capture both broad narrative categories and finer-grained themes Coan et al. (2021) ; Nikolaidis et al. (2025) . Although interpretable, these approaches can be difficult to scale to large parliamentary corpora and often require predefined categories.
blocks.zh: 就分类学构建而言,传统方法往往依靠专家驱动的人工编码,以识别特定域的叙事并构建叙事代码. Hughes等 (2021); Kotseva等 (2023). 最近的工作还开发了分级分类法,既涵盖广泛的叙事类别,又涵盖更细微的主题。 Coan等 (2021); Nikolaidis等 (2025). 这些方法虽然可以解释,但很难推广到大型的议会机构,往往需要预先界定的类别。

blocks.en: The present study integrates these directions into a unified, largely unsupervised workflow. Existing approaches typically address narrative extraction or taxonomy construction as separate tasks Anantharama et al. (2022) ; Otmakhova and Frermann (2025) ; Coan et al. (2021) ; Nikolaidis et al. (2025) . In contrast, our approach combines unsupervised thematic filtering, LLM-assisted extraction of concise narrative statements, and narrative-level clustering to derive narrative families without relying on predefined narrative categories (Fig. 1 ).
blocks.zh: 本研究将这些方向整合到一个统一且基本上不受监督的工作流程中. 现行方法通常将叙述性提取或分类构造作为单独的任务处理Anantharama等(2022年);Otmakhova等(2025年);Coan等(2021年);Nikolaidis等(2025年)。 相形之下,我们的方法结合了无监督的专题过滤,LLM辅助提取简洁的叙事语句,以及叙事层次的分组来得出叙事家族,而不依赖于预先定义的叙事类(图1).

blocks.en: 3 Dataset
blocks.zh: 3 数据集

blocks.en:
The dataset used in this study is based on the Greek Parliament Proceedings, which have been increasingly explored in computational linguistics and political analysis Barmpounis et al. (2024) ; Gavriilidou et al. (2024) ; Lislevand et al. (2024) . A major resource in this area is the Greek Parliament Proceedings Dataset for Computational Linguistics and Political Analysis by Dritsa et al. (2022) . 2 2 2 https://zenodo.org/records/7005201 The Greek Parliament was selected because it constitutes a central institutional arena for political discourse: beyond its legislative and representative functions, it also contributes to the shaping of public opinion and political debate Pätz et al. (2025) ; Treimane (2011) .
The dataset spans July 1989 to July 2020 and therefore does not cover the Tempi train crash. To analyze parliamentary discourse after the event, we extended the corpus with more recent Parliament Proceedings, following the data collection and formatting procedures of Dritsa et al. (2022) .
This ensured consistency with the original dataset and extended the available corpus by five years, from July 2020 to August 2025.
blocks.zh:
本研究中使用的数据集以"希腊议会诉讼"为基础,在计算语言学和政治分析上被越来越多地探索出"巴姆普乌尼斯等"(2024年);"加夫里利杜等"(2024年);"利斯列万德等"(2024年). 这一领域的主要资源是Dritsa等人(2022年)的希腊议会语言和政治分析程序数据集。 希腊议会之所以被选中,是因为它构成了政治讨论的中央机构舞台:除了其立法和代表职能之外,它还有助于形成公众舆论和政治辩论Pätz等(2025);Treimane (2011)。
数据集跨度从1989年7月到2020年7月,因此不涵盖滕皮列车相撞事故. 为了分析事件发生后议会的言论,我们按照Dritsa等人(2022年)的数据收集和格式化程序,以更近期的议会诉讼方式扩展了这一程序。
这确保了与原始数据集的一致性,并将现有数据集延长了五年,从2020年7月延长至2025年8月。

blocks.en:
The extended dataset contains 185,857 speech fragments from 907 parliamentary sitting sessions, stored in a CSV file of approximately 534 MB with 11 metadata fields, including speaker name, sitting date, political party, parliamentary session information, government, electoral region, parliamentary role, and gender.
Since the study focuses on the Tempi train crash, we constructed a sub-corpus covering March 7, 2023, the first relevant parliamentary entry after the crash, to August 28, 2025. This sub-corpus contains 88,058 speeches, which were segmented into 216,396 original paragraphs for paragraph-level thematic filtering. Speech ID and paragraph ID fields were added to preserve traceability between paragraphs and source speeches.
blocks.zh:
扩展数据集包含来自907届议会会期的185 857个发言片段,存储在大约534 MB的CSV文档中,其中包含11个元数据领域,包括演讲人姓名,座位日期,政党,议会会议信息,政府,选区,议会角色和性别.
由于研究的重点是滕皮列车相撞事故,我们建造了分公司,涵盖2023年3月7日,即相撞事故后的第一个相关议会条目,至2025年8月28日. 这个子公司包含88,058个演讲,这些演讲被分割成216,396个原始段落,用于段落级主题过滤. 添加了语音标识和段落标识字段,以保持段落和源词之间的可追踪性。

blocks.en: The paragraph-level corpus was then cleaned by removing procedural or audience-rendered paragraphs, corrupted rows, and paragraphs shorter than 100 characters. Unused metadata fields were dropped, sitting dates were aggregated by month, political party names were standardized in English, and variants of the same party were unified. The cleaned paragraph text was created by lowercasing, punctuation removal, and stress-mark removal. The final analytical dataset contains 117,716 paragraphs with metadata for member name, member gender, sitting date, political party, speech ID, paragraph ID, and cleaned paragraph text. Figure 2 presents monthly paragraph activity across parties; additional political party and gender distribution statistics are provided in Appendix A .

blocks.en: 4 Computational Pipeline
blocks.zh: 4 计算管道

blocks.en: The CART framework consists of three stages that move from parliamentary paragraphs to a narrative taxonomy. First, paragraph-level thematic filtering is used to identify candidate event-related discourse within the larger corpus. Second, LLM-assisted extraction converts relevant paragraphs into concise narrative statements, while excluding paragraphs that do not express a Tempi-specific narrative. Third, narrative-level clustering groups the extracted statements into broader narrative families. This design separates the main analytical units of the study: paragraphs are used for discourse filtering, narrative statements are the product of the extraction, and narrative families form the final taxonomy. Because no predefined narrative categories or relevance labels were available, the pipeline relies primarily on unsupervised methods that exploit the structure of semantic embedding spaces.
blocks.zh: CART框架包括三个阶段,从议会段落转向叙事分类。 首先,段落一级的专题过滤用于确定大实体内与事件有关的候选言论。 第二,LLM辅助提取将相关段落转换为简明的叙述性说明,而排除不表达Tempi特定叙述的段落. 第三,叙事层面的分组将摘录的言论分成更广泛的叙事家庭。 这种设计分离出研究的主要分析单元:段落用于话语过滤,叙事陈述是取出物的产物,叙事家族构成最终分类. 由于没有预设的叙事类别或关联性标签,管道主要依靠利用语义嵌入空间结构的无监督方法.

blocks.en: 4.1 Paragraph-Level Thematic Filtering
blocks.zh: 4.1 段级专题过滤

blocks.en: The first stage aims to reduce the full parliamentary corpus to candidate discourse regions that are likely to contain Tempi-related content. Because no paragraph-level relevance labels were available, we used clustering as an exploratory filtering strategy for grouping semantically related parliamentary paragraphs. Data clustering seeks to identify natural groupings in multidimensional data according to a similarity measure Omran et al. (2007) . In text clustering, however, obtaining clusters that are both semantically coherent and geometrically well separated remains challenging, especially in large, heterogeneous corpora Petukhova et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 第一阶段旨在将完整的议会文书减少到可能包含与Tempi有关内容的候选言论区域。 由于没有段落一级的相关标签,我们利用分组作为探索性过滤战略,将与议会具体相关的段落分组。 数据分组旨在根据类似度量Omran等人(2007年)确定多层面数据的自然分组。 然而,在文本集群中,获得既具有整体一致性又几何分明的集群仍然具有挑战性,特别是在大型、多相异的Corpora Petukhova等人(2025年)中尤其如此。

blocks.en: Paragraphs were represented using contextual embeddings generated with the Qwen3-Embedding-8B model Zhang et al. (2025) . Contextual embeddings provide dense semantic representations whose values depend on the surrounding linguistic context, allowing them to capture meaning shifts more effectively than static representations Jurafsky and Martin (2026) . Since such embeddings are high-dimensional, we applied Principal Component Analysis Jolliffe (2025) before clustering; a dimensionality analysis assessing retained variance and nearest-neighbor preservation is provided in Appendix E .
blocks.zh: 利用由Qune3-Embedding-8B模型Zhang等人(2025年)产生的上下文嵌入表示段落。 上下文嵌入提供了密集的语义表达,其价值取决于周围语言上下文,使得它们能够比静态表达更有效地捕捉到意义转变. Jurafsky and Martin (2026). 由于这种嵌入是高维的,我们在分组之前应用了主要组件分析Jolliffe(2025);附录E提供了对保留差异和近邻保存进行评估的维度分析。

For each paragraph, the Silhouette coefficient Rousseeuw (1987) is defined as: s i = b i − a i max ⁡ ( a i , b i ) , s_{i}=\frac{b_{i}-a_{i}}{\max(a_{i},b_{i})}, (1) where a i a_{i} is the average distance of x i x_{i} from the other paragraphs in its assigned cluster, and b i b_{i} is the minimum average distance of x i x_{i} from the paragraphs of any other cluster. The coefficient captures the balance between cohesion and separation : values close to 1 1 indicate that a paragraph is well matched to its cluster and well separated from competing clusters, values around 0 0 indicate boundary cases, and negative values suggest that the paragraph may be better placed in a different cluster Dudek (2020) .
Since the exact Silhouette coefficient requires pairwise distance computations between all paragraphs, direct evaluation is computationally demanding for large corpora. blocks.en: To determine the number of clusters, we evaluated candidate solutions for k ∈ { 15 , … , 100 } k\in\{15,\dots,100\} . This range was specified in advance as an exploratory search interval, broad enough to allow both general parliamentary themes and more specific event-related subthemes to emerge, while avoiding very small values of k k that would merge distinct topics and very large values that would produce highly fragmented clusters. For each candidate value, we monitored two complementary aggregate versions of the Silhouette score. The first was the micro-averaged Silhouette score , computed as: S micro ​ ( k ) = 1 n ​ ∑ i = 1 n s i , S_{\text{micro}}(k)=\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}s_{i}, (3) where n n is the total number of paragraphs. This aggregation gives equal weight to individual paragraphs and therefore reflects the overall geometric quality of the partition. However, because every paragraph contributes equally, the resulting score is naturally influenced more strongly by large clusters Dudek (2020) . The second was the macro-averaged Silhouette , computed as: S macro ​ ( k ) = 1 k ​ ∑ r = 1 k ( 1 | C r | ​ ∑ x i ∈ C r s i ) , S_{\text{macro}}(k)=\frac{1}{k}\sum_{r=1}^{k}\left(\frac{1}{|C_{r}|}\sum_{x_{i}\in C_{r}}s_{i}\right), (4) where k k is the number of clusters and | C r | |C_{r}| is the size of cluster C r C_{r} . Here, Silhouette values are first averaged within each cluster and then across clusters, so that each cluster contributes equally regardless of its size. This makes the criterion more sensitive to smaller and potentially more specialized thematic groups Pavlopoulos et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 为了确定组数,我们评价了 k {{ 15,...,100} k\in{ 15,\dots 100} 的候选解决方案。 这一范围事先被指定为探索性搜索间隔,范围很广,可以同时出现一般的议会主题和与事件有关的更具体分主题,同时避免 k k 的极小值,这些值会将不同的主题和非常大的值合并起来,产生高度分散的集群. 对于每种候选值,我们监测了Silhouette分数的两个补充汇总版本。 第一个是微平均值的Silhouette分数,计算为: Smicro (k) = 1 n → i = 1 n s i, S_{\text{ micro}} (k) =\frac{ 1}{n}\ sum_{i= 1}^{n} s_{i}, (3) N为段落总数。 这种汇总给个别段落以同等分量,因此反映了分区的整体几何质量. 然而,由于每个段落都同等贡献,由此产生的分数自然会受大型集群Dudek(2020年)更强烈地影响. 第二种是宏平均值Silhouette,计算为:S宏 (k) = 1 k r = 1 k (1 | C ∑ ∑ x i ∈ C s i),S_{\text{macro}} (k) =\ frac{ 1}{k}\ sum_{r= 1}^{k}\left (\frac{ 1}{| C_{r}|}\ sum_{x}\i}\in) C_{r}}s_{i}\rrightr}), (4) kk为组数; C|r| C_{r}|为组数 Cr_{r}. 在这里,Silhouette值首先在每个集群内平均,然后跨集群,这样,每个集群无论大小都会做出同等的贡献. 这使得标准对较小和可能更专业化的专题小组Pavlopoulos等人(2025年)更为敏感。

blocks.en: Both aggregation views were important for the present corpus. Parliamentary discourse is highly uneven: some themes are broad and recurrent, while others appear in smaller but substantively meaningful concentrations. Optimizing only the micro-averaged Silhouette would privilege high-volume clusters, whereas optimizing only the macro-averaged Silhouette could overemphasize small or less stable groups Yuan et al. (2022) . For this reason, among candidate solutions with positive aggregate scores, we selected the value of k k that maximized the harmonic mean of the two criteria: H ⁡ ( k ) = 2 ​ S micro ​ ( k ) ​ S macro ​ ( k ) S micro ​ ( k ) + S macro ​ ( k ) . H(k)=\frac{2\,S_{\text{micro}}(k)\,S_{\text{macro}}(k)}{S_{\text{micro}}(k)+S_{\text{macro}}(k)}. (5) The harmonic mean was used as a conservative combination rule because it penalizes candidate solutions when either the micro- or macro-averaged score is low, favoring partitions that perform reasonably well under both perspectives. As an internal validation criterion, this score is not treated as ground-truth evidence of topical relevance; rather, it is used to select a geometrically coherent candidate partition for subsequent relevance screening and narrative extraction. Using this criterion, the initial paragraph-level partition was set to k = 52 k=52 (the corresponding selection curve is provided in Appendix C ; Fig. 5 ).
blocks.zh: 这两种意见对本文书都很重要。 议会讨论高度不平衡:有些主题广泛而反复出现,而另一些则以较小但实质上有意义的集中形式出现。 优化只有微观平均值的Silhouette才能使高容量的集群享有特权,而优化只有宏观平均值的Silhouette才能过分强调小的或不太稳定的组元等(2022年). 因此,在具有正总分的候选解决方案中,我们选择了使两个标准的谐音平均值最大化的克克值: H → (k) = 2 S micro (k) S macro (k) + S macro (k) . H(k)=\frac{2\,S_{\text{micro}(k)\,S_{\text{macro}(k)}{S_{\text{micro}(k)+S_{\text{macro}(k)}. (5) 口琴指指向保守的组合规则,因为它在微观或宏观平均分数低的情况下惩罚了候选解决方案,有利于在两种观点下表现合理的分割。 作为一项内部验证标准,这一分数不被视为具有专题相关性的地心证据;相反,它被用来选择一个几何连贯的候选人分区,用于随后的相关筛选和叙事提取. 使用此标准,初始段落级别分区被设定为k=52克=52(相应的选择曲线在附录C;图5.).

blocks.en: After obtaining the initial thematic partition, we applied a confidence diagnostic for paragraph cluster assignments, implemented using the CAKE Python package. 3 3 3 https://pypi.org/project/cake-ensemble/ . Additional details on the confidence-scoring procedure are provided in Appendix D . Paragraphs in the lower quartile of the confidence score distribution were removed. This threshold was used as a conservative heuristic to exclude the least stable assignments while retaining most of the corpus for refinement. The corresponding score distribution is reported in Appendix D , Fig. 6 . This confidence-based filtering reduced the influence of ambiguous paragraph assignments before the refined thematic partition was constructed.
blocks.zh: 在获得初始主题分区后,我们对段落集群任务应用了信心诊断,使用 CAKE Python 软件包执行. 3 3 3 https://pypi.org/project/cake-ensemble/ 。 。 。 。 关于打分程序的其他细节见附录D。 信心分数分配的下四分数段落被删除。 这一门槛被用作保守的修炼方法,以排除最不稳定的转让,同时保留大部分的完善手段。 相应的分数分布见附录D,图6. 这种基于信任的过滤在完善专题划分之前减少了模糊段落分配的影响。

blocks.en: Using this confidence-filtered subset, we repeated the same cluster-count selection procedure, again using the harmonic mean of the micro- and macro-averaged Silhouette scores. This second pass selected k = 41 k=41 . The refined paragraph-level thematic partition was then produced using k -means++ initialization to reduce sensitivity to the initial centroid selection.
blocks.zh: 使用这个被置信过滤的子集,我们重复了相同的集群计数选择程序,再次使用微和宏观平均Silhouette分数的谐调平均值. 第二次通过选中 k = 41 k = 41. 随后用 k- means++ 初始化来生产出精细的段落级主题分区,以降低对最初的中间体选择的敏感性.

blocks.en: 4.2 Narrative Extraction
blocks.zh: 4.2 叙述性采掘业

blocks.en: Before extracting narrative statements, it was first necessary to identify which of the refined paragraph-level clusters were substantively related to the Tempi train crash. To support this screening step, we constructed cluster-level metadata for each of the 41 41 refined clusters; the metadata fields are listed in Table 2 in Appendix B . Specifically, for each cluster, we recorded its total paragraph count, retrieved the five paragraphs with the highest CAKE scores, and extracted the top 20 TF-IDF terms by concatenating all paragraphs assigned to that cluster. The high-score paragraphs served as representative cluster examples, while the TF-IDF terms provided a compact lexical summary.
blocks.zh: 在提取叙述性说明之前,首先必须确定哪些经过改进的段落级集群与Tempi列车相干。 为支持这一筛选步骤,我们为41个精细组群中的每一组构建了集群一级元数据;附录B表2列出了元数据领域。 具体地说,对于每一组,我们记录了它的段落总数,检索了CAKA得分最高的五个段落,并通过整理分配给该组的所有段落取出前20个TF-IDF术语。 高分数段落是有代表性的集群实例,而TF-IDF术语则提供了紧凑的词汇摘要.

blocks.en:
These metadata were then provided to the DeepSeek-R1 model through the Amazon Bedrock API. The model received the representative paragraphs together with the top TF-IDF terms and was instructed to generate a concise descriptive title for each cluster while identifying clusters directly or plausibly related to the Tempi train crash. In this step, the LLM was used as an interpretive aid for cluster screening, rather than as the source of the final narrative taxonomy. 4 4 4 Prompts/code: https://github.com/semoglou/cart . Five clusters were identified as directly related to the Tempi train crash or as broader themes likely to contain Tempi-related paragraphs. The LLM-generated titles were: Railway Safety and Infrastructure Reform , Government Accountability and Distrust , Cover-up and Accountability Investigations , Tempi Train Crash Accountability Investigation , Parliamentary Investigative Committee Formation .
Together, these clusters contained 10,229 paragraphs, forming the sub-dataset for narrative analysis. The top five TF-IDF terms in each relevant cluster are presented in Appendix F , Fig. 7 .
blocks.zh:
这些元数据随后通过亚马逊-贝德罗克API提供给了DeepSeek-R1模型. 该模型收到了代表段落以及TF-IDF顶级名词,并被指示为每组生成一个简洁的描述性标题,同时识别与Tempi列车相直接或相近的集群. 在这个步骤中,LLM被用作集群筛选的解释性辅助,而不是作为最终叙事分类学的来源. 4 4 提示/代码:https://github.com/semoglou/cart. 5个组被确定为与Tempi火车相撞事件直接相关,或可能包含与Tempi相干段落的更广泛的主题. 由LLM产生的标题是:铁路安全和基础设施改革、政府问责和不信任、掩护和问责调查、Tempi Train Crash Accountry调查、议会调查委员会的组建。
这些分组共包含10 229个段落,构成叙述分析的分数据集。 附录F,图7列出了每个相关组群中TF-IDF的前五个术语。

blocks.en: To ensure that the final taxonomy was built from topically relevant material, narrative statement extraction was restricted to this Tempi-focused subset. The same LLM was then used for paragraph-level extraction. For each isolated paragraph, the model was instructed either to generate a single concise narrative statement or to mark the paragraph as irrelevant if it was not substantively focused on the Tempi train crash. 5 5 5 Narratives were generated directly in English from Greek source paragraphs. In addition to the paragraph text, the model was provided with the narrative definition established in § 1 , together with the sitting date and the party of the speaker.
blocks.zh: 为了确保最终分类学是用主题相关的材料构建的,叙述性陈述提取仅限于这个以Tempi为重点的子集. 同一LLM随后被用于段级取出. 对于每个被孤立的段落,该模式被指示要么生成一个单一的简明叙事说明,要么将该段标为无关紧要,如果它没有实质性地聚焦于滕皮列车相撞. 5 5 5 希腊来源段落直接用英文编写叙述。 除该款案文外,还向该模型提供了第1节中规定的叙述性定义,以及发言的开庭日期和当事人。

blocks.en: Ultimately, 4,537 narrative statements were generated, accounting for 44.35% of the 10,229 paragraphs processed by the model, while the remaining 5,692 paragraphs (55.65%) were classified as irrelevant to the crash. The narrative yield varied substantially across the five Tempi-related clusters: the two most focused clusters produced narrative statements for 95.25% and 77.63% of their paragraphs, while a third cluster yielded narrative statements for 66.67% of its paragraphs. The remaining two clusters were broader thematic clusters with lower narrative yields, producing narrative statements for 18.26% and 7.63% of their paragraphs. This variation indicates that the selected clusters differed in their degree of direct relevance to the Tempi case, justifying the additional paragraph-level relevance filtering performed during extraction.
blocks.zh: 最终产生了4,537个叙述性陈述,占模型处理的10,229个段落的44.35%,而剩余的5,692个段落(55.65%)被归类为与坠机无关. 与Tempi有关的五个组的叙述结果大相径庭:两个重点最突出的组的叙述陈述占95.25%和77.63%,而第三个组的叙述陈述占66.67%。 其余两组是较广泛的专题组,叙述结果较低,编制叙述性说明的比例分别为18.26%和7.63%。 这一变化表明,选定的集群与Tempi案的直接关联程度不同,因此有理由在提取过程中进行额外的段级关联过滤。

blocks.en: To assess the LLM-assisted extraction step, we conducted a manual annotation study on a sample of retained paragraphs and generated narrative statements. Across five annotators, the extracted narrative statement was selected as the best-fitting option in 84.6% of annotations, with an annotator-level standard error of 1.21 percentage points. Details are provided in Appendix G . 6 6 6 Annotation materials are available at https://github.com/semoglou/cart .
blocks.zh: 为了评估LLM协助提取步骤,我们对保留段落样本进行了人工注释研究,并产生了叙述性说明。 在所有五个注释者中,提取的叙述语被选为84.6%的注释中最适合的选项,注释者级标准误差为1.21%. 详情见附录G. 6 6 说明材料可在https://github.com/semoglou/cart查阅。

blocks.en: 4.3 Narrative Clustering
blocks.zh: 4.3 叙述性分组

blocks.en: After the extraction stage, the resulting narrative statements were encoded as embeddings, following the same representation procedure as in the paragraph-level stage, and grouped into broader narrative families to construct the taxonomy. At this stage, each point in the embedding space represented a semantically condensed narrative statement rather than a raw parliamentary paragraph. This made the narrative-level space smaller, less heterogeneous, and more suitable for finer-grained unsupervised analysis.
blocks.zh: 在取出阶段后,所产生的叙述性陈述被编码为嵌入式陈述,遵循与段落级阶段相同的表述程序,并被分组为更广泛的叙述性家族来构建分类. 在现阶段,嵌入空间中的每一个点都代表着一个精细而简洁的叙述性陈述,而不是一个原始的议会段落. 这使得叙事层面的空间更小,差异更小,更适合更细腻的无监督分析.

blocks.en: This difference motivated the use of different clustering procedures. The paragraph-level stage was designed as a large-scale exploratory filtering step, where scalability, transparency, and robustness were prioritized. For that reason, standard k -means was used to identify broad thematic regions in the parliamentary corpus. In contrast, the narrative-level stage served as the basis for the final taxonomy, where preserving finer distinctions between semantically related narrative groups was more important. A more specialized silhouette-driven procedure was therefore used at this stage.
blocks.zh: 这种差异促使采用不同的分组程序。 段级阶段是作为大规模探索性过滤步骤设计的,其中优先考虑可扩展性、透明度和稳健性。 为此,采用了标准k -- -- 意思来确定议会文书中广泛的主题区域。 与此相反,叙事阶段是最后分类的基础,在叙事阶段,对叙事群体进行更细微的区分更为重要。 因此,在现阶段采用了更专业的由圆筒驱动的程序。

blocks.en:
To determine the appropriate number of narrative clusters, we employed the Composite Silhouette method. 7 7 7 https://pypi.org/project/compsil/ . Additional details on the cluster-selection procedure are provided in Appendix H .
This validation procedure was computationally feasible because the extracted narrative corpus was substantially smaller than the paragraph corpus used during thematic filtering, making it practical to assess the stability of candidate solutions across repeated data perturbations. Using this criterion, the selected number of clusters was set to k = 10 k=10 .
blocks.zh:
为了确定叙述性分组的适当数目,我们采用了综合硅胶方法。 7 7 7 https://pypi.org/project/compsil/。 关于分组选择程序的其他细节见附录H。
这一验证程序在计算上是可行的,因为提取的叙述体大大小于专题过滤中使用的分包体,因此,通过反复的数据干扰来评估候选解决方案的稳定性是切合实际的。 使用此标准,选定的组数被设定为k=10克=10.

blocks.en:
Having fixed the number of clusters, we partitioned the narrative embeddings using a silhouette-driven variant of k -means designed to produce more reliable centroid updates in semantically fine-grained representation spaces, K-Sil Semoglou et al. (2026) . Additional details are provided in Appendix I .
Under identical experimental conditions, standard k -means produced an overall Silhouette score of approximately 0.16 0.16 , whereas the K-Sil partition reached approximately 0.20 0.20 . This indicates improved cohesion and separation, and we therefore retained the K-Sil solution at k = 10 k=10 as the final partition used to construct the narrative taxonomy (Table 1 ). Cluster summaries for both solutions are provided in Appendix J , including prevalence and mean cluster-level Silhouette.
blocks.zh:
在固定了星团数量后,我们用一个 silhouette 驱动的 k - 意思的变体对叙事嵌入进行了分化,该变体旨在在精细的分泌代表空间中产生更可靠的百分行星更新, K-Sil Semoglou等 (2026). 附录一提供了其他细节。
在相同的实验条件下,标准k-意指总的Silhouette得分约为0.160.16分,而K-Sil分区则达到约0.200.20分. 这表明了凝聚力和分离的改善,因此我们保留了K-Sil溶液为k=10k=10作为构建叙事分类法的最后分区(表1). 附录J提供了两种解决办法的分组摘要,包括流行率和平均分组级别Silhouette。

blocks.en: 5 Resulting Narrative Taxonomy
blocks.zh: 5 结果叙述分类

blocks.en: The final taxonomy was constructed from the K-Sil partition of the 4,537 extracted narrative statements (Appendix J , Fig. 9 ). Each narrative cluster was interpreted using high-silhouette narrative statements together with contrastive terms derived from comparisons with the nearest neighboring clusters. This resulted in ten narrative families, presented in Table 1 . The taxonomy organizes recurring parliamentary interpretations concerning the crash itself, accountability, investigation procedures, institutional responsibility, railway safety, privatization, and political exploitation. The cluster labels summarize claims expressed in parliamentary discourse rather than making factual assertions about the events. Figure 3 illustrates the temporal evolution of the discovered narrative families (see Appendix Figs. 11 and 12 for complementary party-level analyses).

blocks.en: The largest narrative family is Cluster 1, Government cover-up of Tempi accountability , accounting for 23.32% of the extracted narrative corpus. It frames the investigation as being obstructed through concealment, institutional manipulation, or interference with accountability processes, expressing a government-led cover-up interpretation of the Tempi crash. The second-largest family is Cluster 6, Railway safety remains neglected and unsecured (18.45%). It shifts attention from the investigation to the condition of the railway system, emphasizing neglected safety mechanisms, non-operational infrastructure, and insufficient reform.
blocks.zh: 最大的叙事家庭是第一组,政府掩盖了Tempi的责任,占提取的叙事资料的23.32%。 它将调查定为通过隐瞒、机构操纵或干扰问责程序而受阻,表达了政府主导的对Tempi空难的掩盖解释。 第二大家族是第6组,铁路安全仍然被忽视,没有安全保障(18.45%)。 它将注意力从调查转向铁路系统的状况,强调被忽略的安全机制,非运营基础设施,以及改革不足.

blocks.en: Clusters 0, 2, and 5 form a broader group of accountability and causality narratives. Cluster 0, Judicial and procedural obstacles to accountability , focuses on the institutional and legal processes through which responsibility is investigated, emphasizing judicial evidence, investigative committees, criminal accountability, and procedural constraints. Cluster 2, Systemic governance failures caused preventable disaster , presents the crash as the outcome of broader governance failures rather than an isolated event. Cluster 5, Negligence caused the preventable Tempi train crash , links infrastructure negligence, governmental incompetence, and preventability directly to the crash.
blocks.zh: 第0、2和5组构成更广泛的问责和因果关系说明组。 第0组,问责制的司法和程序障碍,侧重于调查责任的机构程序和法律程序,强调司法证据、调查委员会、刑事责任和程序限制。 第2组(系统治理失败造成可预防的灾害)将坠机视为更广泛的治理失败的结果,而不是孤立的事件。 第5组“疏忽”造成可预防的Tempi火车相撞,

blocks.en:
A second set of clusters captures more specific responsibility-oriented narratives. Cluster 3, Tempi crash resulted from systemic criminal failure , frames the disaster as the result of unresolved systemic and potentially criminal failures. Cluster 7, Legal framework shields ministers from accountability , focuses on ministerial responsibility and legal or constitutional mechanisms presented as limiting criminal liability. Cluster 9, Railway privatization caused systemic safety failures , attributes railway safety failures to privatization, fragmentation, and insufficient investment guarantees.
Cluster 8, Opposition exploits the tragedy for political gain , differs from the other families by framing the tragedy as politically instrumentalized by opposition parties rather than assigning responsibility for the crash or its investigation. It also has the highest mean Silhouette score, making it the most geometrically distinct narrative family.
Because several clusters were semantically close, we examined their semantic proximity using centroid cosine similarity (Fig. 4 ), complemented by contrastive TF-IDF terms to distinguish closely related narrative families. The closest pair was Clusters 6 and 9 (cosine similarity 0.590). Although both concern railway safety failures, Cluster 6 emphasizes ongoing safety neglect, whereas Cluster 9 attributes these failures specifically to privatization and railway fragmentation. Likewise, Cluster 1 captures a broader cover-up narrative, while Cluster 4 focuses on obstruction of the investigation. Cluster 2 expresses a systemic-governance interpretation, whereas Cluster 5 directly attributes the Tempi crash to negligence.

blocks.en:
The temporal distribution in Fig. 3 suggests that the salience of the narrative families changed over the course of the parliamentary debate. Activity in March 2023 appears to reflect the immediate framing of the crash, with responsibility, preventability, and railway safety already prominent. The renewed increase in late 2023 coincides with greater visibility of institutional and procedural narratives concerning the investigation, accountability mechanisms, and legal responsibility.
A stronger peak around the first anniversary in March 2024 indicates renewed parliamentary attention to accountability and railway safety. The largest increase in early 2025 reflects a broader intensification of the debate: governmental responsibility and railway safety remain prominent, while ministerial accountability, privatization, and political exploitation become more visible.
Overall, the pattern is consistent with a shift from immediate interpretations of the crash toward a debate over institutional responsibility, legal accountability, and its broader political meaning.
blocks.zh:
图3中的时间分布表明,在议会辩论期间,叙事家庭的突出地位发生了变化。 2023年3月的活动似乎反映了坠机的即时框架,责任、可预防性和铁路安全已经十分突出。 2023年末再次增加的同时,关于调查、问责机制和法律责任的机构和程序说明的能见度也有所提高。
2024年3月一周年前后的更强劲高峰表明议会重新关注问责和铁路安全. 2025年初增幅最大反映了辩论范围更广:政府责任和铁路安全仍然突出,而部级问责制、私有化和政治剥削则更加明显。
总的来说,这种模式符合从立即对坠机事件的解释转向就机构责任、法律问责及其更广泛的政治含义进行辩论的转变。

blocks.en: Taken together, the results show that parliamentary discourse surrounding the Tempi train crash is organized around multiple recurring narrative families that capture distinct yet overlapping interpretations of responsibility, institutional failure, accountability, and political meaning.
blocks.zh: 结果显示,议会围绕Tempi火车相撞事件的讨论围绕着多个反复出现的叙事家庭进行,这些家庭对责任、体制失败、问责制和政治意义作了明确但相互重叠的解释。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
This study investigated recurring political narratives surrounding the Tempi train crash through a computational analysis of Greek Parliament proceedings. To this end, we introduced CART , a computational pipeline for extracting narrative statements and organizing them into a data-driven taxonomy without relying on predefined narrative categories.
The taxonomy identified ten narrative families spanning accountability, safety, systemic governance failures, negligence, privatization, and the political interpretation of the tragedy. Their prominence also evolved over time, reflecting changes in parliamentary debate. Together, these findings provide a structured account of the recurring political interpretations surrounding the Tempi crash and illustrate how CART supports their systematic extraction and organization.
Methodologically, the analysis highlights the complementary roles of confidence-informed filtering, balanced cluster selection, and silhouette-driven clustering in constructing the resulting narrative taxonomy.
blocks.zh:
这项研究通过对希腊议会诉讼的计算分析,调查了围绕"通皮"火车相撞事件反复出现的政治叙事. 为此,我们引入了CART(CART),这是一个计算管道,用于提取叙事语句,并将其组织为数据驱动的分类学,而不依赖于预先定义的叙事类.
分类法确定了涉及问责制、安全、系统治理失败、疏忽、私有化和对悲剧的政治解释的10个叙述家庭。 它们的重要性也随着时间的推移而演变,反映了议会辩论的变化。 这些调查结果共同提供了围绕Tempi空难反复出现的政治解释的有条理的叙述,并说明了CART如何支持系统的提取和组织。
从方法上讲,分析突出了信心知情过滤、平衡的集群选择以及由硅胶驱动的集群在构建由此产生的叙事分类学中的互补作用。

blocks.en: More broadly, CART is designed for text collections containing recurring interpretations of a target issue. Its application requires appropriate text preprocessing and sufficient recurring interpretive content, while contextual metadata can support extraction and subsequent analyses where available. By deriving narrative families directly from textual data rather than predefined categories, CART provides a flexible framework for systematically identifying and organizing recurring narratives across diverse textual corpora.
blocks.zh: 更广泛地说,CART是为包含对目标问题反复解释的文本集而设计的. 其应用需要适当的文本预处理和足够的经常性解释内容,而上下文元数据则可以支持提取和后续分析。 CART通过直接从文字数据而不是预先定义的类别中取出叙事家族,提供了一个灵活的框架来系统地识别和组织跨不同文字结构的反复叙事.

blocks.en: 7 Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 限制

blocks.en: As with other unsupervised approaches, the outcomes of CART depend partly on the semantic representations and clustering configurations employed. The framework addresses these methodological considerations through systematic cluster selection, confidence-informed refinement, and clustering diagnostics. Nevertheless, alternative embedding models or parameter configurations may yield different levels of narrative granularity.
blocks.zh: 与其他不受监督的办法一样,CART的成果部分取决于所使用的语义表达和集群组合。 该框架通过系统分组选择、在知情的情况下完善信心和分组诊断来解决这些方法方面的考虑。 尽管如此,替代嵌入模型或参数配置可能会产生不同水平的叙事颗粒.

blocks.en: The LLM-assisted extraction stage also involves modeling choices, particularly regarding the language model and prompting strategy. Although the extracted narrative statements were assessed through manual annotation, further comparisons across model configurations could provide additional evidence of their consistency.
blocks.zh: LLM辅助取出阶段也涉及模型选择,特别是关于语言模型和激励策略的选择. 虽然提取的叙述性说明是通过人工注释加以评估的,但是对模型配置的进一步比较可以进一步证明它们的一致性。

blocks.en:
To assess the reliability of paragraph-level cluster assignments in Section 4.1 , we employed CAKE Semoglou and Pavlopoulos (2026) , implemented using the CAKE package. 8 8 8 https://pypi.org/project/cake-ensemble/ . The method jointly estimates how consistently each paragraph is assigned and how well it is supported by the learned clustering structure across repeated clustering runs. The resulting confidence scores were used as a post-clustering filtering criterion. Paragraphs in the lower quartile of the confidence score distribution were removed before constructing the refined thematic partition.

blocks.en: To assess the narrative extraction procedure described in Section 4.2 , we conducted a forced-choice validation study on a sample of 100 paragraphs. blocks.zh: 作为二级诊断,注释者之间的平均对等原始协议为89.5%,而平均对等的Cohen's $\kappa为0.616。 这些数值仅作为补充证据报告,因为研究的主要目的是评估注释者是否将所提取的叙述性说明选取在替代品之上。

blocks.en: These results suggest that, under a constrained forced-choice validation design, the extracted narrative statements were usually selected as the best-fitting option. The lower selection rates for the random, false, and “None of the above” options indicate that the task retained meaningful distractors and ambiguous cases, while the extracted statements were selected substantially more often than the alternatives.
blocks.zh: 这些结果显示,在受限制的强制选择验证设计下,所提取的叙述性陈述通常被选为最佳选择. 随机、虚假和“上述任何一种”选项的选择率较低,这表明任务保留了有意义的分散注意力和模棱两可的情况,而所提取的语句比其他语句选取次数多得多。

blocks.en: A supplementary analysis identified annotator disagreement in 26 of the 100 paragraphs. Non-extracted selections included all distractor categories (31 “None of the above”, 24 false narratives, and 22 random narratives). Extracted–random narrative TF-IDF similarity was higher in paragraphs with disagreement (0.0293 vs. 0.0119), with a moderate positive association between similarity and disagreement (Spearman’s ρ = 0.306 \rho=0.306 ).
blocks.zh: 一项补充分析发现,100个段落中有26个段落的注释者有分歧。 非摘录的选择包括所有分心者类别(31个“无上列”、24个虚假叙述和22个随机叙述)。 摘录的-随机叙事 TF-IDF 相似性在有分歧的段落中较高(0.0293 vs. 0.0119),相似性与有分歧的段落之间有中度正联(Spearman's $ = 0.306\rho = 0.306).

blocks.en: Appendix H Composite Silhouette Cluster Selection
blocks.zh: 附录H 复合圆筒组选择

blocks.en:
To determine the number of narrative clusters, as described in Section 4.3 , we employed Composite Silhouette Semoglou et al. (2027) , implemented using the Composite Silhouette package. 10 10 10 https://pypi.org/project/compsil/ . The method extends the balancing strategy adopted during paragraph-level clustering by jointly considering the micro- and macro-averaged Silhouette scores. The former reflects the overall geometric quality of the partition, whereas the latter gives equal weight to smaller clusters that may correspond to less frequent but analytically meaningful narratives.
Rather than combining these complementary perspectives through a fixed harmonic mean, Composite Silhouette evaluates and adaptively combines them across repeated clustering runs on subsampled data, reducing sensitivity to any single sample or aggregation strategy.
blocks.zh:
为了确定第4.3节所描述的叙述类群的数目,我们采用了综合Silhouette Semoglou等人(2027年),采用综合Silhouette软件包执行。 该方法通过共同考虑Silhouette的微观和宏观平均分数,扩展了在段级分组期间采用的平衡战略. 前者反映了分区的整体几何质量,而后者则对较小的集群给予同等的分量,这些集群可能与较少的但分析性有意义的叙述相对应.
复合Silhouette不是通过固定的口号来综合这些互补视角,而是通过重复的分组对次抽样数据进行评价和适应性结合,降低对任何单一样本或汇总策略的敏感性。

blocks.en: In the present study, this validation procedure selected k = 10 k=10 as the final number of clusters.
blocks.zh: 在本研究中,这一验证程序选择了k=10克=10作为集群的最后数量.

blocks.en: Appendix I Silhouette-Weighted Clustering
blocks.zh: 附录一

blocks.en:
To construct the final narrative taxonomy (§ 4.3 ), we employed K-Sil Semoglou et al. (2026) , a silhouette-driven instance-weighted variant of k -means.
Unlike standard k -means, which updates cluster centroids as unweighted means of all assigned instances, K-Sil reweights each instance according to a silhouette-based confidence signal. In K-Sil , centroid updates are computed as softmax-weighted means of the assigned instances with an adaptive temperature parameter that controls the sharpness of the weighting distribution. Embeddings that are more clearly associated with their assigned cluster therefore exert greater influence on centroid updates, whereas embeddings located in more ambiguous boundary regions contribute less. This weighting scheme is well suited to narrative data, where some statements express a distinctive interpretation while others lie near the boundary between related themes.
blocks.zh:
为了构建最后的叙事分类法(第4.3节),我们采用了K-Sil Semoglou等人(2026年),这是由 silhouette 驱动的克-指的量子变体。
与标准k-意指将集群百分子作为所有指定实例的未加权手段来更新不同的是,K-Sil根据基于 silhouette 的置信信号对每个实例进行再加权. 在 K-Sil 中, 中间行星更新被计算为指定实例的软马克思加权手段,其适应温度参数控制了加权分布的锐度。 因此,与所分配的集群有更明确关联的嵌入物对中间行星的更新具有更大的影响,而嵌入物则位于较模糊的边界地区,其作用较小。 这种权重方案非常适合叙述性数据,有些发言表达了一种独特的解释,而另一些则接近相关主题之间的界限.
